span.p:
S3 multipart
90% pe wifi gaya
-> file tukdon me, har tukda apne signed URL pe
S3 har tukde ki rasid (ETag) de, pahunche tukde bache rehte
(multipart)
wifi gaya -> sirf bache tukde bhejo, shuru se nahi
COMPLETE kabhi nahi -> kuch din baad S3 hata de (lifecycle abort)
